Name: Bathrooms For Everyone (CP)
Author: yuninocorn
Description:
[b][size=4]General[/size][/b]

Have you ever wondered how Pelican Town's residents stay clean when there are no bathrooms anywhere to be found? Yeah, that has to change.
This content pack adds bathrooms to:

- Marnie's ranch
- Clint's house
- Elliott's cabin
- Haley and Emily's house
- Harvey's room
- Alex' house
- Leah's cabin
- Lewis' house
- The Saloon
- Sam's house
- Sandy's Oasis
- Robin's house
- Pierre's store
- Pam's house (the community upgrade one)

[b][size=4]Compatibility and Permissions[/size][/b]

As of right now, my custom assets don't have any recolored versions. Please feel free to create and upload recolored versions of the tilesheet (with credit) if you want to add a specific recolor. The same goes for modded buildings - if you want to make and upload your own version of this mod for modded buildings and use my assets, feel free, as long as you give credit and link to this mod. 

Issues can occur with mods that alter the layout/appearance of the vanilla interior maps. If a bathroom is misplaced because of this, you can disable it with Generic Mod Config Menu. There is a config option to toggle every bathroom, named after one of the NPCs living in that building. In Stardew Valley Expanded, for example, you'll have to disable Sandy's bathroom as it is not compatible with the SVE layout of the oasis. All other bathrooms do work with SVE, though.

If you have any issues or questions, please feel free to leave a message in the comments tab or contact me on Discord (yuninocorn).

Enjoy!
